title: Letterbox full — card would not fit
driver_says: The letterbox was stuffed full, I couldn't even get a card in.
driver_knows: The box was overflowing with free papers. Nobody answered the bell. The parcel went back in the van and no card was left.
follow_up: how the recipient will be told
whether the parcel is back in the van
tip: Husemannstraße 14: the letterbox is full, a card will not fit — ring, or take it back.

title: Building site mud across the path
driver_says: The whole path is mud from the building site, the trolley just sank in.
driver_knows: A digger has churned up the path to the door. There are boards laid along the left-hand side that hold. The parcel was delivered.
follow_up: whether there is a way in that holds
tip: Mud across the path from the building site — keep to the boards on the left.
